turns: Hi Claire, it's Noelle. The Adeyemi fasting draw, I finally got that done this morning. Mark it done.
And Cedarbrook wants a second round of INR draws the day after tomorrow, same as tomorrow's, a few residents missed the window. So that's two visits. Put the second one on.

notes: Two guards. (1) Turn 1 completes an existing job without saying which day it is on (it is two days back): Claire must find the Adeyemi row by name and mark it completed, in place, on today-2. A fresh 'completed' row instead of completing the seeded one trips maxRowsAdded 1 once the Cedarbrook row is also added; removing it instead of completing it fails the completed-status expectation. (2) Turn 2 says explicitly that the same job happens again on another day ('a second round', 'same as tomorrow's', 'two visits'): the Cedarbrook INR work must exist twice, once on tomorrow and once on the day after tomorrow, which is exactly one row added. count 2 across the two dates fails a Claire that moves the seeded row instead of adding a second one, and the grader's duplicate check is suspended for this title by count 2, because the duplication is legitimate here. One authorization ask is tolerated because confirming that a near-identical second row is intended is a reasonable single question before the write; asking twice, or asking before the plain 'mark it done', fails. Westgate and the needle order are never discussed and must be untouched; the read-back of tomorrow must name Cedarbrook and the Westgate drop and must match the database. Nothing may land on today.
